comment: Copy to local.json next to agentic-factory.py and adjust. Machine settings only; the test command and the stack description live in config.json and AGENTS.md. Every key is optional; leave one out to keep config.json's value (or the default named below).
comment_model: Copilot model. Leave it out to use config.json's model.
comment_copilot: The command that starts Copilot CLI, as a list. Leave it out to use copilot from PATH. On Windows it must not be a .cmd or .bat file.
comment_jira_mcp_server: The --jira mcp route (the default outside a pipeline): the name of your Atlassian MCP server in `copilot mcp list`. Default atlassian. Add it at user level (~/.copilot/mcp-config.json), with `copilot mcp add --transport http atlassian https://mcp.atlassian.com/v1/mcp`, never in the project's .mcp.json or .github/: the Jira calls run outside the project. Log in once interactively: copilot, /mcp, atlassian, Authenticate.
comment_jira_site: The --jira mcp route: your Jira Cloud address, with no path. It is not a secret. Without it, the script takes JIRA_BASE_URL. Jira Data Center has no MCP route; use --jira api.
comment_jira: The --jira api route (the default in a pipeline): credentials come from the environment, never from this file: JIRA_BASE_URL, JIRA_API_TOKEN, and JIRA_EMAIL for Jira Cloud only (Basic auth). Without JIRA_EMAIL, the token goes out as a Bearer token (Jira Data Center personal access token).
